\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{backgrounds}
\begin{document}
\tikzset{
  every picture/.style={line width=1ex},
  every on background layer/.style={every picture}
}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw [->] (0,0) -- (2,1);

  \scoped[on background layer]
    \draw[red] (0,1) -- (2,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
